sections.label: / work
sections.body: Senior BI Analyst at **Indeed**, on Salesforce CRM Analytics. The seat is central analytics for global Sales, CS, SBS, and adjacent teams. The big project this quarter is **context engineering** - aligning our agentic models and semantic layers with correct, actionable data so the GTM teams can move on it.

sections.label: / direction
sections.body: Thinking about where to be most useful next - **Senior Analytics, BizOps, or Product-leaning roles** at Seed → Series D startups, AI-native companies, and FAANG. Teams where the data layer gets a seat in the launch meeting, not just the post-mortem. See [/about](/about) for the longer version.

sections.label: / learning
sections.body: Halfway through an **MS in Data Analytics** at WGU. Closing the two or three CS-shaped gaps in my analyst toolkit - algorithms, distributed systems, and a refresher on the linear-algebra bits I've been Googling for a decade. Slow, deliberate, not optimized for the credential.

sections.label: / training
sections.body: BJJ at **Paragon BJJ** in Austin, 3–4× a week. Black belt since 2020. Currently working on **headquarters and tripod passes** I keep messing up, and a **crab ride** sequence my coach swore would "just click." It mostly hasn't.

sections.label: / reading
sections.body: *Nudge* (Thaler & Sunstein) on the work side. *The Name of the Wind* (Rothfuss) on the not-work side.

sections.label: / shipping
sections.body: This site is the active side project. Built with **Next.js + MDX + Vercel**, source on [GitHub](https://github.com/jvermaelen/personal-site). **Three case studies are live**; the rest are in the writing pile.
